en_US: Cyrus: In my world there was a lake
here. Lake Valor.
...So this is where it went.
An old Trainer Card. The name has
worn away.
Hometown: Twinleaf.
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} got a Calm Shard!
Cyrus: It wasn't yours to fix. You
fixed it anyway.
Cyrus: The lake hangs over us.
Whatever it swallowed is still here.
The board is warped and bleached.
The paint is almost gone.
LAKE VALOR - ROWBOATS FOR HIRE
Please return boats by sundown.
A frame of bolted iron, rusted
through. Straps hang from it.
It is the same shape as the frames
in the cave. Only much older.
A wooden rowboat, tipped onto its
side in the dry lakebed.
Its planks have gone grey and soft.
Lake water still pools under a seat.
